dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual linear narrowing from the mid-body region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light slate-grey with a consistent median pixel intensity, appearing several shades darker than mature white.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse dark-grey patches concentrated primarily along the dorsal ridge midline.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; the gradient between light-grey and dark-grey regions shows no sharp boundaries.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A thin, dark longitudinal line follows the central dorsal axis toward the posterior, indicating a structural ridge indentation.

other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is clearly visible as a distinct circular orifice at the anterior terminus of the dorsal surface.
